claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for release on the present record, based on aggregate readiness and deployment-stage risk management, while acknowledging that a named launch segment remains below target and that legal review on disclosure is still unresolved.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the action satisfies the release policy threshold.
Treat a weakness affecting a named launch use case or contractual customer segment as potentially material under the provided policy text.
Do not treat low-volume or non-core product labels as resolving materiality when named commitments exist or legal review is pending.
Require evidence of either resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance before treating certification as policy-clean.
Separate operational readiness evidence from disclosure-policy compliance; both matter, but one does not prove the other.
evidence_requests: Provide any approved pre-launch risk acceptance covering the Spanish-language billing support gap.
Provide the final legal determination on whether the gap must be disclosed.
Provide the actual model-card or launch disclosure showing this limitation was disclosed, if it has already been documented.
Provide evidence that the named pilot commitments were amended, waived, or otherwise no longer make this segment a named launch use case.
specific_concerns: A named launch use case misses target by 2.1 percentage points, which is directly relevant to materiality under the stated policy.
The affected segment is named in three international pilot commitments, so the record supports possible materiality rather than resolving it away.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required is still open, leaving a required policy predicate unresolved.

The policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and no approved risk acceptance is in evidence.

Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support operational readiness, but do not by themselves satisfy the disclosure-policy condition for a potentially material limitation.
unsupported_claims: That certification is policy-compliant on the current record despite the unresolved disclosure question.
Any implication that the materiality dispute has been adequately resolved for launch.
Any implication that ongoing monitoring can substitute for required disclosure or approved risk acceptance under the stated policy.
